faq.a: Yes. Besides matcha we make espresso, cappuccino, flat white, latte and more — see our menu.
Ceremonial matcha is the highest grade of green tea from the first spring harvest, stone-milled into a fine powder. It has a vivid color and a silky, non-bitter taste.
Yes, you can reserve a table by phone — find the contact on the Contact page.

latte.lead: Creamy matcha latte made with ceremonial matcha from Japan — at NOA café in Prague Old Town.
body: Looking for the best matcha latte in Prague? At NOA Matcha Café we make our matcha latte from premium ceremonial matcha, hand-whisked with a bamboo chasen into a silky foam. No pouch powder, no bitterness — just a rich, natural taste.

sections.h: How we make our matcha latte
sections.p: Every latte is freshly whisked from ceremonial matcha and topped with the milk of your choice. Have it hot or iced — just the way you like it.
Besides the classic matcha latte we offer fruity variations — apricot, raspberry, strawberry — and signature drinks like Coconut Cloud or Maple Sea Salt. See the full menu and prices.
Find us at Revoluční 763/15, Prague 1 – Old Town. Open Mon–Sat. Drop by for a cup of premium matcha.

oldtown.h1: Matcha café in Prague Old Town
oldtown.lead: NOA Matcha Café — matcha and premium coffee at Revoluční 763/15, Prague 1 (Old Town).
body: Looking for a calm café in Prague Old Town? NOA Matcha Café is a spot in the heart of Prague 1 where ceremonial matcha from Japan is the star — but you'll also find great espresso here. Sit down, slow down and enjoy a cup in a pleasant atmosphere.

sections.p: Ceremonial matcha latte (hot or iced), fruity and signature matcha drinks, classic coffee (espresso, cappuccino, flat white, latte) and a calm place to sit.
Revoluční 763/15, 110 00 Prague 1 – Old Town. The Dlouhá třída tram stop (lines 6, 8, 15, 26) is right outside, and metro line B at Náměstí Republiky is about a 5-minute walk.
Mon–Sat 8:00–20:00, closed on Sundays.

ceremonial.lead: The highest grade of matcha from the first spring harvest — at NOA café in Prague Old Town.
body: What is ceremonial matcha and why does it matter? Ceremonial grade matcha is the finest, highest-quality grade of green tea matcha. The leaves are shaded for weeks before harvest, hand-picked at the first spring harvest and stone-milled into a silky-fine powder. The result is a vivid green color, natural sweetness and no bitterness.

sections.h: How it differs from regular matcha
sections.p: Culinary matcha is cheaper, coarser and more bitter — great for baking. Ceremonial matcha is meant to be sipped on its own or in a latte, because its flavor is smooth and full. We use ceremonial grade only.
Every cup is hand-whisked with a bamboo chasen into a fluffy foam — hot or iced. Have it as pure usucha or as a creamy matcha latte.
Come to Revoluční 763/15, Prague 1 – Old Town. Open Mon–Sat.

togo.lead: Your favorite matcha to go — fast, with no compromise on quality.
body: In a hurry? Grab your matcha and coffee to go. We'll make a fresh matcha latte from ceremonial matcha in a takeaway cup — hot or iced — in no time. Same quality as at the bar.

sections.p: Matcha latte (hot / iced), fruity and signature matcha drinks and classic coffee. All freshly made to order.
Drop by Revoluční 763/15, Prague 1 – Old Town. Right by the Dlouhá třída tram stop and a few minutes from Náměstí Republiky metro — perfect on your way to work or a walk.
Mon–Sat 8:00–20:00, closed on Sundays.

iced.lead: Refreshing iced matcha made with ceremonial matcha — perfect for hot days.
body: Iced matcha (iced matcha latte) is the cool, refreshing version of our premium matcha. We whisk ceremonial matcha, pour it over ice with milk or a plant-based alternative — for a refreshing drink with a vivid color and natural sweetness, no bitterness.

sections.p: Classic iced matcha latte, fruity (apricot, raspberry, strawberry) and signature Coconut Cloud with fluffy foam. All from ceremonial matcha.
Natural energy from L-theanine and caffeine without the jitters, less sugar than sodas and a full flavor even over ice. A great alternative to iced coffee.
Revoluční 763/15, Prague 1 – Old Town. Open Mon–Sat, dine-in or to go.

catering.lead: A matcha bar for your event — corporate event, wedding, opening, workshop.
body: Want something other than coffee at your event? We'll bring a matcha bar with ceremonial matcha and make fresh matcha lattes right at your venue. Perfect for corporate events, team buildings, weddings, store openings or workshops.

sections.p: A mobile matcha bar with a barista, ceremonial matcha latte (hot or iced), fruity and signature variations and plant-based milk. We adapt to your guest count and theme.
Corporate events, team buildings, weddings, store openings, trade fairs, workshops and private parties — in Prague and beyond.
Write to us via Contact — we'll prepare a tailored quote based on guest count and venue.

recipe.h1: How to make matcha latte at home
recipe.lead: A simple step-by-step matcha latte recipe — and where to get quality matcha.
body: You can make a matcha latte at home in a few minutes. The key is quality ceremonial matcha and proper whisking. Here's our method — and when you don't feel like whisking, drop by for the real thing.

sections.p: Ceremonial matcha (1–2 g), a bamboo chasen whisk (or an electric frother), a sieve, warm water (~80 °C, not boiling) and milk of your choice.
1) Sift the matcha into a bowl. 2) Add a little hot water (80 °C). 3) Whisk with the chasen in a 'W' motion for about 20 s until foamy. 4) Pour into a glass with milk (hot or over ice). Done.
Matcha makes the flavor — reach for ceremonial grade from the first harvest. Or come taste ours at Revoluční 763/15, Prague 1.
